title: Mighty King
author: David Moffitt / Sue C. Smith / Travis Cottrell
copyright: 2003 New Spring / CCTB Music / First Hand Revelation Music
content:
[Chorus]
Mighty King, conquering Hero
triumpaht Warrior, Redeemer, set us free.
Mericful Savior, glorious Shield and Defender,
You are mighty, Your are the mighty, mighty King.
You are the mighty, You are the mighty King.

[Verse 1]
Blessed is He who comes in the name,
who comes in the name of the Lord.
Blessed is He, the One who will reign
in power forever more.
Before the rocks can cry out, You are Holy,
and Lord, You are worthy.
Before the tree clap their hands for Your glory,
we will rise to sing Your praise!

[Verse 2]
Blessed is He who comes in the name,
who comes in the name of the Lord.
Blessed is He, the One who will reign
in power forever more.
From everlasting the King of the Ages,
the Alpha, Omega, to Everlasting,
we lift up our praises.
Jesus, let Your Kingdom come.

[Bridge]
Mighty in battle, might to regin,
mighty in power, mighty to save,
mighty in purpose, mighty in love,
mighty forever and ever in us.

Praise ev'ry morning
God's re-creation of the new day

title: My Offering
author: Brett Williams
content:
[Verse 1]
Here in my heart
Forever grateful
Is all my love
Forever faithful
Lord You're all I have all I need all I want

[Verse 2]
My dearest friend
My true companion
You took me in
Lost and abandoned
Lord You're all I have all I need all I want

[Slide 3]
And this is just a token of devotion
To heaven's love as deep as any ocean

[Chorus 1]
All my life all my breath every word every step
Every beat of my heart will sing
Every joy every fear every smile every tear
Is the least that my soul can bring
It's my offering

[Verse 3]
I can't explain
This transformation
But by Your Spirit
I'm awakened
Lord You're all I have all I need all I want

[Verse 4]
I can't repay
So great a mercy
Poured out each day
But I am learning
Lord You're all I have all I need all I want

What God has willed what God has planned

Stands One who is my Savior

Christ died to save me this I read

You count it strange so once did I
Before I knew my Savior

My strength my solace from this spring
That He who lives to be my King
Once died to be my Savior

title: NKB 003
content:
[Slide 1]
1
Terpujilah Allah, hikmatNya besar,
begitu kasihNya tuk dunia cemar,

[Slide 2]
1
sehingga dibrilah PutraNya Kudus
mengangkat manusia serta menebus.

[reff]
Pujilah, pujilah! Buatlah dunia bergemar,
bergemar mendengar suaraNya.

[reff]
Dapatkanlah Allah demi PutraNya,
bri puji padaNya sebab hikmatNya.

[Slide 5]
2
Dan darah AnakNyalah yang menebus
mereka yang yakin kan janji kudus;

[Slide 6]
2
dosanya betapapun juga keji,
dihapus olehNya, dibasuh bersih.

title: No One Ever Cared For Me Like Jesus
author: Charles F. Weigle
content:
[Chorus 1]
No one ever cared for me like Jesus
There's no other friend so kind as He
No one else could take the sin
And darkness from me
O how much He cared for me

[Verse 1]
I would love to tell you
What I think of Jesus
Since I found in Him
A friend so strong and true
I would tell you how
He changed my life completely
He did something
That no other friend could do

[Verse 2]
All my life was full of sin
When Jesus found me
All my heart was full
Of misery and woe
Jesus placed His strong
And loving arms around me
And He led me in the way
I ought to go

[Verse 3]
Ev'ry day He comes to me
With new assurance
More and more I understand
His words of love
But I'll never know
Just why He came to save me
Till someday I see
His blessed face above

title: No Other Gods
author: David Moffitt
content:
[Chorus]
We will have no other gods before You
Nothing on earth will compete for Your throne
You are sov'reign I Am
And You reign in our hearts alone
We will exalt You on high forever
King of all kings
And the Lord of all lords
We will have no other gods before You

[Verse 1]
The God of the heavens
The Ancient of Days
The God of our fathers
And God of my praise
The Alpha Omega
Beginning and End
Forever and ever
Your kingdom will stand
We come to bow before You now
We come to lay our lives down

[Verse 2]
Our Maker Creator
Before time began
Messiah and Savior
Redeemer and Friend
Our Rock of Salvation
So faithful and true
We give all the glory
And honor to You
For You alone are worthy
Of our never-ending love

an orphan home one day
And stopped just for a moment
Just to wacth the children play

And he began to cry

I nobody's child, I'm nobody's child
Just like a flower
I'm growing wild
No mommy's kisses
and no daddy's smile
Nobody wants me
I'm nobody's child

and I'm left here all alone

And I'm left behind

sometimes it gets so lonely
I wish that I could die

there'd be a home for me.

title: O Little Town Of Bethlehem
author: Lewis H. Redner Phillips Brooks
content:
[Verse 1]
O little town of Bethlehem,
How still we see thee lie;
Above thy deep and dreamless sleep,
The silent stars go by.

[Slide 2]
Yet in thy dark streets shineth
The everlasting Light;
The hopes and fears of all the years,
Are met in thee tonight.

[Verse 2]
For Christ is born of Mary
And gathered all above;
While mortals sleep the angels keep
Their watch of wondering love.

[Slide 4]
O, morning stars together
Proclaim the holy birth;
And praises sing to God the King
And peace to men on earth.

[Verse 3]
How silently, how silently,
The wondrous gift is giv'n;
So God imparts to human hearts,
The blessings of His heaven.

[Slide 6]
No ear may hear His coming,
But in this world of sin;
Where meek souls will
Receive Him still,
The dear Christ enters in.

[Verse 4]
O, holy child of Bethlehem,
Descend to us we pray;
Cast out our sin and enter in,
Be born in us today.

[Slide 8]
We hear the Christmas angels,
The great glad tidings tell;
O, come to us abide with us,
Our Lord, Emmanuel.

copyright: © 2001 New Spring Publishing (ASCAP) (a div. of Brentwood-Benson, dba GreatWorshipSongs.com.)
content:
[Verse 1]
How wide is Your love
That You would stretch Your arms
And go around the world
And why for me
Would a Savior's cry be heard
I don't know
Why You went where I was meant to go
I don't know why You love me so

[Chorus]
Those were my nails, that was my crown
That pierced Your hands and Your brow
Those were my thorns, those were my scorns
Those were my tears that fell down
And just as You said it would be
You did it all for me
And after You counted the cost
You took my shame, my blame on my cross

[Verse 2]
How deep is Your grace
That You could see my need
And choose to take my place
And then for me
These words I'd hear You say
Father no
Forgive them for they know not what they do
I will go because I love them so

title: One day at a time.
content:
[Slide 1]
Im only human,
Im just a woman
Help me believe what I believe
and all that I am

[Slide 2]
Show me the stairway,
I have to climb
Lord, for my sake teach me to take
One day at a time.

[Reff:]
One day at a time, sweet Jesus
Thats all Im asking from you
Just give me the strength to do everyday what I have to do

[Slide 4]
Yesterday gone, sweet Jesus
And tomorrow may never be mine
Lord, help me today,
Show me the way, one day at a time.

[Slide 5]
Do you remember,
when You walked among men
Well, Jesus You know
if youre looking below
Its worse now than then

[Slide 6]
Steeling and cheating,
violence and crime
So for my sake, teach me to take
One day at a time.

[Reff:]
One day at a time, sweet Jesus
Thats all Im asking from you
Just give me the strength to do everyday what I have to do

[Slide 8]
Yesterday gone, sweet Jesus
And tomorrow may never be mine
Lord, help me today,
Show me the way, one day at a time.

title: One Of These Days
author: Jeromy Deibler
content:
[Chorus 1]
One of these days
I'm gonna see the hand
That took the nails for me
One of these days
I'm gonna hold the key
Of the mansion built for me

[Slide 2]
One of these days
I'm gonna walk the streets of gold
That were paved for me
One of these days
I'm gonna see my Savior face to face
One of these days

[Verse 1]
One of these days I'm gonna fly
Over the mountain
One of these days I'm gonna ride
On the silver lining
One of these days I'm gonna witness
All I've been missing
One of these days

[Slide 4]
One of these days I'm gonna do
All the things that I've never done
I'm gonna finish all the races
That I've run but I've never won
And I'm gonna see a million faces
And recognize everyone
One of these days

[Verse 2]
One of these days I'm gonna say
Just what became of me
On the day that I believed
When You took myself from me
And I believe I will say
What I would have been
If You didn't save me
One of these days

[Slide 6]
And one of these days I'm gonna talk
With all the saints
That have gone before
And in their sandals I will walk
And we will sit along the shore
And I will learn all the things
That I never knew before
All this and more

[Bridge]
One of these days I'll finally be
In a place where
There's no more need
No more pain and no more grief
No more foolish disbelief
And all the joy there will be
When at last we finally see
One of these days

title: Opo wana natas e
content:
[Slide 1]
Opo wana natas e
Tembone se mengale ngale
Tembone se mengale ngale
Pakatuan pakalawiden

[Slide 2]
Kuramo kalalei u langit
Tentumo kalalei un tana
Kuramo kalalei un tana
Tentumo kalalei ta in tou

[Slide 3]
Nikita in tou karia
Eni mapa susuat uman
Eni mapa susuat uman karia
Wia si Opo wananatas

[Slide 4]
Si Opo wana natas
Sia si matau ampeleng
Sia si matau ampeleng
Mamuali wia mbawoin tana

[Slide 5]
God in heaven
Look down on the people in the world
Look down on the people in the world
May we have long life and prosperity

[Slide 6]
Your will be done on earth/country
as it is in heaven
Your will be done upon people
as it is on earth/country

[Slide 7]
We are, as human, my friend
all the same
all the same, my friend
to God

[Slide 8]
God in heaven,
He knows everything
He knows everything
Whatever is going to happen on earth/country

Tak pernah ku lihat
Kau membiarkan
Untuk selamanya
Orang benar tertindas

[Slide 3]
Oh, segala perkara
'kan dapat ku tanggung
Didalam Engkau ya Tuhan

[Slide 4]
Yang telah memberikan
Padaku kekuatan
Tak pernah ku lihat
Kau berubah setia

title: Papaya, mangga, pisang, jambu
content:
[Slide 1]
Papaya, mangga, pisang, jambu
Dibawa dari Pasar Minggu

[Slide 2]
Disana banyak penjualnya
Eh., di kota banyak pembelinya.

[Slide 3]
Papaya, buah yang berguna
Bentuknya sangat sederhana

[Slide 4]
Rasanya manis tidak tawar
Ah...., membuat badan sehat segar.

[Slide 5]
Papaya, jeruk, jambu, rambutan
Duren, duku dan lain-lainnya

[Slide 6]
Marilah mari kawan-kawan semua
Membeli buah-buahan.

[Slide 7]
Papaya, tuk makanan rakyat
Karena sangat bermanfaat

[Slide 8]
Harganya juga tak mengikat
Ah..., setalen tuan boleh angkat.

Ku harus akan FirmanMu

title: People Of God
author: Wayne Watson
content:
[Chorus 1]
We're the people of God
Called by His name
Called from the dark
And delivered from shame
One holy race saints ev'ryone
Because of the blood
Of Christ Jesus the Son

[Verse 1]
With our lips
Let us sing one confession
With our hearts
Hold to one truth alone
For He has erased our transgression
Claimed us and called us
His own His very own

[Verse 2]
Hear us O spirits of darkness
So you will know where we stand
We are His servants purchased with scars
Bought by the blood of the Lamb
The blood of the Lamb

title: Persahabatan
content:
[Slide 1]
Raihlah janji yang Tuhan bri
Didalam hidupmu yang suci

[Slide 2]
Serasa aku tak percaya
Harapan Dia beri dalam hidupku

[Slide 3]
Kita slalu berdekatan
Tak terasa kini kan berpisah

[Slide 4]
Persatuan hati yang terbuka
Yang membuat kita kuat

[Slide 5]
Persahabatan yang kekal
Bila Yesus beserta
Persahabatan tak kenal perasaan kecewa

[Slide 6]
Sampai waktunya tiba
Pulang ke rumah Bapa

[Slide 7]
Waktu hidup tak panjang
Bersahabatlah

title: PKJ 027
content:
[PKJ 27]
Nyanyikanlah Nyanyian Baru

[Slide 2]
1
Nyanyikanlah nyanyian baru bagi Allah, Pencipta cakrawala.

[Slide 3]
1
Segala Serafim, Kerubim, pujilah Dia, besarkanlah nama-Nya.

[reff]
Bersorak-sorai bagi Rajamu! Bersorak-sorai bagi Rajamu!

[Slide 5]
2
Puji Dia, wahai mentari, wahai bulan, sembahlah Dia terus.

[Slide 6]
2
Dan wahai bintang-bintang terang yang gemerlapan, muliakan Penciptamu.

[reff]
Bersorak-sorai bagi Rajamu! Bersorak-sorai bagi Rajamu!

[Slide 8]
3
Wahai langit yang mengatasi sgala langit, mazmurkanlah Tuhanmu.

[Slide 9]
3
Hai air di atas langit, turut memuji Tuhan, muliakan Penciptamu.

[reff]
Bersorak-sorai bagi Rajamu! Bersorak-sorai bagi Rajamu!

[Slide 11]
4
Biar bergemuruh samudra dan isinya serta isi dunia.

[Slide 12]
4
Dan biar sungai, gunung, bukit, lembah bertepuk tangan bersama-sama.

[reff]
Bersorak-sorai bagi Rajamu! Bersorak-sorai bagi Rajamu!

[Slide 14]
5
Wahai raja-raja dan pembesar di bumi yang memrintah dunia

[Slide 15]
5
Teruna, anak dara, yang tua dan yang muda, ucap syukur padaNya.

[reff]
Bersorak-sorai bagi Rajamu! Bersorak-sorai bagi Rajamu!

[Slide 17]
6
Nyanyikanlah nyanyian baru bagi Allah, semua ciptaanNya.

[Slide 18]
6
Semesta alam, pujilah Tuhan yang disorga, nyanyikan. Haleluya!

[reff]
Bersorak-sorai bagi Rajamu! Bersorak-sorai bagi Rajamu!

title: PKJ 138
content:
[PKJ 138]
Setia-Mu, Tuhanku, Tiada Bertara

[Slide 2]
1
SetiaMu, Tuhanku, tiada bertara, di kala suka, di saat gelap.

[Slide 3]
KasihMu, Allahku, tidak berubah, Kaulah Pelindung abadi, tetap.

[Reff]
SetiaMu, Tuhanku, mengharu hatiku,
setiap pagi bertambah jelas.

[Slide 5]

title: PKJ 147
content:
[PKJ 147]
Disini Aku Bawa, Tuhan

[Slide 2]
1
Di sini aku bawa, Tuhan,
persembahan hidupku, semoga berkenan.

[Slide 3]
1
Berapalah nilainya, Tuhan, dibandingkan
berkatMu yang tlah Kau limpahkan.

[Slide 4]
1
Trimalah, Tuhan, O trimalah, Tuhan!

[Slide 5]
2
Tanganku yang kecil, ya Tuhan,
belum mencari makan sendiri, ya Tuhan.

[Slide 6]
2
Terimalah hatiku, Tuhan, menjadi
persembahan yang Tuhan perkenan.

[Slide 7]
2
Trimalah, Tuhan, O trimalah, Tuhan!

[Slide 8]
3
Kuingat firmanMu, ya Tuhan,
yang mengajarkan kami mengingat yang kecil:

[Slide 9]
3
Berkati semuanya, Tuhan, supaya
persembahan tetap mengalir trus.

[Slide 10]
3
Trimalah, Tuhan, O trimalah, Tuhan!

title: Power Love
content:
[Slide 1]
Lord, I come to You
Let my heart be changed, renewed
Flowing from the grace
That I've found in You

[Slide 2]
And Lord I've come to know
The weaknesses I see in me
Will be stripped away
By the power of Your love

[Chorus]
Hold me close
Let Your love surround me
Bring me near
Draw me to Your side

[Slide 4]
And as I wait
I'll rise up like the eagle
And I will soar with You
Your Spirit leads me on
In the power of Your love

[Slide 5]
Lord, unveil my eyes
Let me see You face to face
The knowledge of your love
As You live in me

[Slide 6]
Lord renew my mind
As Your will unfolds in my life
In living everyday
In the power of Your love

Semua orang nanti dapet
berkatnye

title: Rudolph the red nose reindeer
content:
[Slide 1]
Rudolph the red nose reindeer
Had a very shiny nose

[Slide 2]
And if you ever saw it
You would even say it grows

[Slide 3]
All the other reindeer
use to laugh and call his name

[Slide 4]
The never let poor rudoph
join in any reindeer games

[Slide 5]
then one foggy christmas eve
santa came to say

[Slide 6]
rudoph with your nose so bright
won't you guide my sleigh tonight

[Slide 7]
The how the reindeer love him
as they shouted out with glee

[Slide 8]
Rudoph the red nose reindeer
You'll go down in history

title: S'eperti Bapa sayang anakNya
content:
[Slide 1]
Bapa,
besar sungguh kasih setiaMu
Nyata sungguh perlindunganMu

[Slide 2]
Tak satu kuasa,
mampu pisahkan
Aku dari kasihMu.

[Slide 3]
Bapa, ajarku slalu hormatiMu
Ajarku turut perintahMu

[Slide 4]
Brikanku hati,
tuk menyembahMu
Dan bersyukur stiap waktu.

[Slide 5]
Sperti Bapa sayang anakNya
Demikianlah
Engkau mengasihiku

[Slide 6]
Kau jadikan biji mataMu
Kau berikan, semua yang ada padaMu.

[Slide 7]
Sperti Bapa sayang anaknya
Demikianlah
Kau menuntun langkahku

[Slide 8]
Hari depan indah Kau beri
RancanganMu yang terbaik bagiku.

title: Sabda Alam
content:
[Slide 1]
Kicau burung bernyanyi
tanda buana membuka hari
dan embunpun memudar
Menyongsong fajar.

[Slide 2]
Sejenak ku terlena
Akan kehidupan yang fana
Nikmat alam semesta
Nusa indah nirmala.

[Slide 3]
Serasa pagi tersenyum mesra
Bertiup bayu membangkit sukma
Adakah esok kau senyum jua
Memberi hangatnya sejuta rasa.

[Slide 4]
Sabda alam
Menghanyutkan suasanaku
Kadang-kala kebosanan mencekam jiwa

[Slide 5]
Sabda alam
Berbuah kodrat tak tertanam
Rasa cinta, rasa nista
Bersatu padu

content:
[Slide 1]
Semua harta
didalam dunia
Semua tahta
yang dapat tergapai

[Slide 2]
Takkan bisa menggantikan Kasih Bapa

[Slide 3]
Semua karya
yang tlah terlukiskan
Semua nada
yang telah terdengar

[Slide 4]
takkan bisa
menandingi cintaMu

[Slide 5]
Sampai habis bumi berlalu
Sampai siang malam menyatu

[Slide 6]
Kan ku puja
dan ku sembah
Engkau ya bapaKu

[Slide 7]
Sampai namaMu ditinggikan
Disetiap hati
dan bangsa

[Slide 8]
Kasih sayangMu
dan setiaMu
kan menyertaiku

pada mezbahMu ya Tuhan

yang Kau ingini

title: seputih bulu domba
content:
[Slide 1]
Tak Kau lupakan diriku
Kau ingat ku adalah debu

[Slide 2]
Tetapi Kau meninggikannya
dihadapan malaikatMu

[Slide 3]
Tak Kau hapuskan namaku
Dari kitab kehidupanMu

[Slide 4]
Kau tak malu mengakuinya
Dihadapan Bapa

[Slide 5]
Kau Allah yang tiada mengingat lagi
Segala kesalahanku
Yang telah Engkau ampuni

[Slide 6]
Walau dosaku merah
bak kain kesumba

[Slide 7]
Engkau menjadikanku
Putih, seputih bulu domba

title: Shine Jesus shine
content:
[Slide 1]
Lord, the light of Your love is shining
In the midst of the darkness shining

[Slide 2]
Jesus light of the world shine upon us

[Slide 3]
Set us free by the truth
You now bring us
Shine on me, shine on me

[Slide 4]
Shine Jesus shine
Fill this land with the Father's glory

[Slide 5]
Blaze spirit blaze
Set our hearts on fire

[Slide 6]
Flow river flow
Flood the nation

[Slide 7]
With grace and mercy
Send forth Your word
Lord, and let there be the light

[Slide 8]
Lord, I come to You aawesome presence
From the shadows into Your radiance
By the blood I may enter You brightness

[Slide 9]
Search me, try me
Consume all my darkness
Shine on me, shine on me

[Slide 10]
Shine Jesus shine
Fill this land with the Father's glory
Blaze spirit blaze
Set our hearts on fire

[Slide 11]
Flow river flow
Flood the nation
With grace and mercy

[Slide 12]
Send forth Your word
Lord, and let there be the light

[Slide 13]
As we gaze on your kingly brightness
So our faces display Your likeness
Ever changing from glory to glory

[Slide 14]
Nearer here our lives tell Your story
shine on me, shine on me
Here I am wholly available

[Slide 15]
As for me
I will serve the Lord

title: Shine like a stars
content:
[Slide 1]
Look at the world we live today
Look at the hurting everywhere
Let us see mercy and Your grace
Overflowed in every place

[Slide 2]
Let us one with You today
And let Your glory fall
Teach us to live in rightenousness
Teach us love in one accord

[Slide 3]
Guide us to live everyday
As we worship in Your court
Let us declare Your majesty
And let glory fall

[Slide 4]
We will shine
Shine like a stars above
Shining in Your light
Guided by Your love

[Slide 5]
Let Your fire burn in us
Burning like the sun
As we glorify
and show Your kingdom come

[Slide 6]
In all the earth
We will shine like stars above
As we're burning like the sun

title: Show Me Your Glory
author: Brad Avery / David Carr / Mac Powell / Marc Byrd /
content:
[Chorus 1]
Show me Your glory
Send down Your presence
I want to see Your face
Show me Your glory
Majesty shines about You
I can't go on without You Lord

[Verse 1]
I caught a glimpse of Your splendor
In the corner of my eye
The most beautiful thing I've ever seen
And it was like a flash of lightning
Reflected off the sky
And I know I'll never be the same

[Verse 2]
When I climb down the mountain
And get back to my life
I won't settle for ordinary things
I'm gonna follow You forever
For all of my days
I won't rest 'til I see You again

ever stop lights

see the kids bunch

title: Softly and tenderly
content:
[Chorus 1]
Come home, come home.
Ye who are weary, come home.

[Slide 2]
Earnestly, tenderly Jesus is calling,
Calling, "O sinner, come home!"

[Verse 1]
Softly and tenderly Jesus is calling,
Calling for you and for me.

[Slide 4]
See, on the portals,
He's waiting and watching,
Watching for you and for me.

[Verse 2]
Why should we tarry
When Jesus is pleading,
Pleading for you and for me?

[Slide 6]
Why should we linger
And heed not His mercies,
Mercies for you and for me?

[Verse 3]
Time is now fleeting;
The moments are passing,
Passing from you and from me.

[Slide 8]
Shadows are gathering;
Death's night is coming,
Coming for you and for me.

[Verse 4]
Oh for the wonderful
Love He has promised,
Promised for you and for me!

[Slide 10]
Though we have sinned,
He has mercy and pardon,
Pardon for you and for me.

title: Sometimes By Step
author: Beaker / Rich Mullins
content:
[Chorus 1]
Oh God You are my God
And I will ever praise You
Oh God You are my God
And I will ever praise You
I will seek You in the morning
And I will learn to walk in Your ways
And step by step You'll lead me
And I will follow You all of my days

[Verse 1]
Sometimes the night was beautiful
Sometimes the sky was so far away
Sometimes it seemed too steep
So close you could touch it
But your heart would break
Sometimes the morning came too soon
Sometimes the day could be so hard
There was so much work left to do
But so much you'd already done

[Verse 2]
Sometimes I think of Abraham
How one star he saw had been lit for him
He was a stranger in this land
And I am that no less than he
And on this road to righteousness
Sometimes the climb can be steep
I may falter in my steps
But never beyond reach

Dia ubah hidupku bahrui hatiku
Sesuatu terjadi saat datang di altarNya

Syukur kuucapkan atas semua perbuatanMu
Hidupku diubahkan
Sejak Kau tinggal didalam hatiku

Kasih dan kebaikanMu didalam duniaku

[Slide 5]
Sbab hanya Kau yang ubahkan duniaku

title: Sungguh ku bangga Bapa
content:
[Slide 1]
Sungguh ku bangga Bapa
Punya Allah seperti Engkau
Sungguh ku bangga Yesus
Atas s'gala pengorbananMu

Tak ingin aku hidup
Lepas dari kasihMu
KasihMu menyelamatkan

Memang tiada berarti bila
Dibanding dengan kasihMu

[Slide 4]
Namun ku ingin memberi
Dengan sukacita di hati
Kar'na ku tahu ini
Menyenangkan hatiMu

Sembahku hanya untukMu
Tahta pujian bagiMu

content:

To give it away to You

When I don't have the strength
To give it away to You Jesus

How many times
Have I turned away
The number is the same
As the sand on the shore
Every time You've taken me back
And now I pray
You'll do it once more

How many times
Have I gone astray
The number is the same
As the stars in the sky
Every time You've taken me back
And now I pray
You'll do it tonight

Ular beracun pada yang minta roti

[Reff:]
Tangan Tuhan sedang merenda
Suatu karya yang agung mulia

[Slide 6]
Saatnya kan tiba nanti
Kau lihat pelangi kasihNya

title: tell the world
content:
[Slide 1]
For God so loved the world
He gave us His only Son
Jesus Christ our Saviour
He most precious one.

[Slide 2]
He has sent us message of love
And sent those who hear
To bring the message to everyone
With voice loud and clear.

[Slide 3]
Let us tell the world of His love
The greatest love
The world has known

[Slide 4]
Search the world for those
Who have walk astray
And lead them home

[Slide 5]
Fill the world darkest corner
With His love from up above

[Slide 6]
Walk every step, every mile
Every road
And tell the world, tell the world
Of His love
(tell the world of His love)

title: Thank You Lord
author: Bessie Sykes / Seth Sykes
content:
[Chorus 1]
Thank You Lord for saving my soul
Thank You Lord for making me whole
Thank You Lord for giving to me
Thy great salvation so rich and free

[Verse 1]
Some thank the Lord for friends and home
For mercies sure and sweet
But I would praise Him for His grace
In prayer I would repeat

[Verse 2]
Some thank Him for the flow'rs that grow
Some for the stars that shine
My heart is filled with joy and praise
Because I know He's mine

[Verse 3]
I trust in Him from day to day
I prove His saving grace
I'll sing this song of praise to Him
Until I see His face

author: Travis Cottrell, David Moffitt, Sue C. Smith

Whenever You call my name,

You are irrestiable.
Whatever You have to say,

That would be unthinkable.

You have turned my life around.

Knowing You is all that matters.

I'm Yours and Yours forever
'cause You have captured my heart.
Jesus You are the love of my life.

And I've never known a love like this before.
You're everything I'll ever need and more.

And I'm always goona follow where You go,
'cause I belong to You and You alone.

title: the power of the cros
content:
[Verse 1]
A lonely hill
A rugged tree
Time stands still and waits for my answer
This sacrifice is calling me to a life
Of total surrender

[Chorus 1]
The power of the cross is moving in my life
'Cause the power of Your blood has saved me
The power of the cross still draws me to Your side
'Cause the power of Your love has changed me
Oh let my life be lost in the power of the cross

[Verse 2]
Lord most high
Hope of man
You are my Redeemer and Savior
All my days are in Your hand
All my praise will be Yours forever

[BRIDGE]
Where mercy was great and grace was free
Where pardon was multiplied to me
Where my burdened soul found liberty
Hide me in the power of the cross

title: Tuhan Kau b’rikan cintaMu
content:
[Slide 1]
Tuhan Kau brikan cintaMu
Tiada pernah berkesudahan
Kuingin nikmati selamanya

[Slide 2]
Perbuatan ajaib tanganMu
Warnai hari hidupku
BersamaMu ku tak akan goyah

[Slide 3]
Kau Allah perlindungan hidupku
Perisai dan kekuatanku
KasihMu kekal selamanya

[Slide 4]
Tiada yang lain dalam hidupku
Cintaku bagiMu
Hanya Engkau Kekasihku
Kucinta slamanya

title: Tuhan ku rindu
content:
[Slide 1]
Tuhan ku rindu
Masuk dalam hadiratMu
Jiwaku menanti

[Slide 2]
Bawaku mendekat kepadaMu
Dalam kemuliaanMu yang kudus

[Slide 3]
Ku nanti Engkau
Allah Kuasa dalam kemuliaan yang kudus

[Slide 4]
Ku sembah Engkau
Allah Kuasa dalam kemuliaan yang kudus

[Slide 5]
Lord, I thirst for You
I long to be in Your presence

[Slide 6]
My soul will wait on You
Father draw me nearer

[Slide 7]
Draw ne nearer to the beauty of Your holiness

[Slide 8]
I will wait for You Almighty God
In the beauty of Your holiness

[Slide 9]
I will worship You
Almighty God
In the beauty of Your holiness

Yesus cinta saya

[Slide 4]
Saling mengasihi
Saling mengampuni
Saling melayani
Itulah Firman Tuhan.

title: tuntunan kasihMu
content:
[Slide 1]
Ajar aku untuk mengikuti tuntunan kasihMu, Tuhan
Di setiap langkah hidup yang aku jalani

Bimbing aku tuk dapat pahami hikmat serta rencanaMu
Agarku lalui hidup sesuai FirmanMu

[Slide 3]
Ada saat dalam hidupku
Banyak jalan
yang bercabang
Dan ku tak tahu jalannya
Harus ku pilih dan ku jalani

[Slide 4]
Tuhan ku mohon pimpinanMu
Kau pelita kakiku
Agarku tak sesat arah

[Slide 5]
Ajar aku Tuhan
untuk senantiasa
Mengikuti tuntunan kasihMu

title: Undone
author: Brett Williams / Jason Ritchie / Tommy Coomes
copyright: 2003 Coomesietunes / Jason Ritchie Music / Brett Williams
content:
[Verse 1]
Here before Your throne of grace
Resting here in Your embrace
My Savior God my truest friend
Where in the world do I begin

[Chorus 1]
I'm undone I'm speechless
Overwhelmed by You
Your love knows no limits
And I'm the living proof

[Verse 2]
Many times I drift away
Still Your faithfulness remains
You made this frozen river flow
And I just want to let You know

[BRIDGE]
Words cannot tell You
How much I love You
All of the things that You are
Lost in this ocean
Of deepest devotion
Lord You have captured my heart

title: We were the reason
content:
[Slide 1]
As a little children we would dream a Christmas mourn
And all the gifts and toys,
we knew we find

[Slide 2]
But we never realize
a baby born one blessed night
Give us
the greatest give
of our life.

[Slide 3]
We were the reason
that he gave His life
We were the reason
that He suffered and died

[Slide 4]
To a world that was lost,
He gave all He could give
To show us the reason to live.

[Slide 5]
Ill finally found the reason
for living
Its in giving every part
of my heart to him

[Slide 6]
In all that I do
every word that I say
Ill be giving my heart
just for Him, for Him.

[Slide 7]
As the years when by,
we learn more about gifts
Giving of ourselves
and what that means

[Slide 8]
On the dark and cloudy day
a man hung crying in the rain
Because of love 2x.

I am strong when I am on Your shoulder
You raised me up to more where I can be

title: You Reign
author: Mark Harris / Tony Wood
copyright: 2003 New Spring / Row J, Seat 9 Songs / RyanLynn Publishing
content:
[Chorus 1]
Long before You ever said let there be light
Long after this world has had it's final night
Great God in heaven
You'll be where You've always been
Seated on Your holy throne

[Slide 2]
King of kings looking down on men
You are ruler above all the nations
Sovereign through all generations
Lord You reign

[Slide 3]
One day all kings will tremble before You
I will bow down and adore You
Lord You reign

[Slide 4]
Morning and night the sky shouts Your majesty
Saying the whole universe is under Your feet
This is the peace in my heart
The strength of my soul
Whatever happens in life
This much I know
You are in control

[Slide 5]
There is none like You
Lord You are worthy
Ev'rything You do always is perfect
There is none like You Lord
You are worthy
Ev'rything You do always is perfect

To worship You my King
I will find my strength
In the shadow of Your wings

Your love oh Lord
Reaches to the heavens
Your faithfulness
Stretches to the sky
Your righteousness
Is like the mighty mountains
Your justice flows
Like the ocean's tide

[ENDING]
Your love O Lord
Reaches to the heavens
Your faithfulness
Stretches to the sky
